m: अवे (√ इ), -एति (impf. -अयत्; Pot. 1. sg. इयाम्; pr. p. f. अवा-यति, RV. viii, 91, 1) to go down, go down to (acc.), go to, RV.; (Imper. 3. pl. Ā. आयन्ताम्) to rush down, AV. xi, 10, 8 (cf. आवै); (Imper. अवैतु) to go away, RV. v, 49, 5; AV. i, 11, 4; to look upon, consider, Śak.; Vikr.; Bhaṭṭ.; to perceive, conceive, understand, learn, know, MBh. &c.; (with Inf.), Kathās. : Intens. (pl. -ईमहे) to beg pardon for, conciliate, RV. i, 24, 14 and vii, 58, 5.
a: अवे — {c2c} P. [अव इ] 1 (a) To know, understand, learn, perceive, be aware of; अवैमि ते तस्यां सोदर्यस्नेहं Ś. 4; अवैमि चैनामनघेति R. 14. 40; द्विषदभियोग इत्यवैति Mu. 1. 7.; अवैमि ते सारं Ku. 3. 13; R. 2. 35. (b) To know, look upon or consider, regard, तदवैमि कैतवं Ku. 4. 9; Ś. 5. 11; Bk. 7. 33; किं मां सुतक्षयकरं सुत इत्यवैषि Ve. 5. 2. --2 To go or move away. --3 To go to, approach (with acc.). --4 To rush upon, come down upon (Ved.) --Freq. or Pass. (अवेयते) To beg pardon for, conciliate.

m: अ-वेध्य mfn. unpierceable, not to be pierced, Kathās.
अ-वेणि mfn. having no braid of hair, L.
not commingled (as the waters of rivers), L.
single, being by itself, Buddh. (cf. अवेणिक.)
a: अवेणि — a. 1 Not braided. --2 Having no braid of hair. --3 Not flowing together or commingled (as the waters of rivers).

m: अ-वेश-सदृश mfn. not like prostitution, Mṛcch.
अ-वेद m. pl. not the Vedas, ŚBr. xiv.

v: tri॰ vedanAM na jAnAti jYA--ka asa॰ samA॰ । vedanAnaBijYe “avedanAjYaM kuliSakzatAnAm” kumA॰ ।

m: 1. अ-वेदन n. not knowing, Mn. v, 60.
2. अ-वेदन mfn. painless, Suśr.
अ-वेद—विद् mfn. not knowing the Vedas, GopBr.; Mn. iv, 192.
अ-वेद—विद्वस् m(dat. -विदुषे)fn. id., MBh. xii, 8967.
अ-वेद—विहित mfn. not prescribed in the Vedas, Mn. v, 43.
अ-वेदयान mfn. (pr. p. Ā.) not knowing, not ascertaining, Mn. viii, 32.
a: अवेदयान — a. Not knowing, not ascertaining.

v: strI vedirvedanam aBAve na॰ ta॰ । jYAnABAve “na ceda vedirmahatI vinazwiH” vf॰ u॰ । parizkftaBUmi SUnye tri॰
m: 1. अ-वेदि f. ignorance, BṛĀrUp.
2. अ-वेदि mfn. without a Vedi or sacrificial altar, KātyŚr.
अ-वेदिन् mfn. having no knowledge, ŚBr. xiv; BhP.; MārkP.
अ-वेदोक्त mfn. id., MBh. xiii, 4397.
अ-वेद्या f. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) non-admission of the Ahaṃkāra.

s: puM, (vida + Ryat । tato, na vedyaH naYsamAsaH .) govatsakaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ vACura itiBAzA । ajYeye tri ॥ (avivAhyaH । yaTA, -- “vyaBicAreRa varRAnAmavedyAvedanena ca । svakarmmaRAYca tyAgena jAyante varRasaNkarAH” ॥ iti manuH .)
v: tri॰ na vedyaH jYeyaH । 1 ajYeye । vida--lABe Ryat । 2 alaBye 3 avivAhyastriyAM strI “vyaBicAreRa varRRAnAmavedyAvedanena ca” manuH । 4 govatse pu॰ Sabdaca॰ ।
m: 1. अ-वेद्य mfn. not to be known, unascertainable, MBh. xii, 11765
2. अ-वेद्य mf(आ)n. (√ 3. विद्), not to be married, Mn. x, 24
अ-वेद्य m. a calf, L.
a: अवेद्य — a. 1 Unknowable, secret. --2 Unattainable. --द्यः A calf. --द्या (A woman) not to be married; Ms. 10. 24.

m: अवेक्ष् (√ ईक्ष्), अवेक्षते to look towards, look at, behold, TS.; ŚBr. &c.; (1. sg. ईक्षे) to perceive, observe, experience, RV. viii, 79, 9; R.; Bhag. &c.: Ā. (rarely P., e.g. 2. sg. अवेक्षसि, MBh. ii, 2158) to have in view, have regard to, take into consideration, Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. अवेक्षयति, to cause to look at, KātyŚr.
a: अवेक्ष् — {c1c} A. [अव-ईक्ष्] 1 To look at, perceive, observe, behold. --2 To aim at, have in view; योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेहं Bg. 1. 23; take into account or consideration, have regard to; अवेक्ष्य धातोर्गमनार्थमर्थविद् R. 3. 21; किमपि निमित्तमवेक्ष्य V. 5; त्रिदिवोत्सुकयाप्यवेक्ष्य मां R. 8. 60 out of regard for me; K. 329; oft. with न meaning ‘not to mind or heed,’ ‘disregard’; R. 11. 69; न हि कमलिनीं दृष्ट्वा ग्राहमवेक्षते मतंगजः M. 3 (it may also mean ‘expect’ here); निद्रावशेन भवता ह्यनवेक्ष्यमाणा R. 5. 67. --3 To look to or after, attend to; अवेक्षमाणं महतीं मुहुर्मुहुः Śi. 1. 10. --4 To take care of, guard, watch over, protect; वसुधेयमवेक्ष्यतां त्वया R. 8. 83; श्लाघ्यां दुहितरमवेक्षस्व जानकीं U. 1, 7. --5 To think, consider; यदवोचदवेक्ष्य मानिनी Ki. 2. 3. --6 To look into or examine, inspect; स कदाचिदवेक्षितप्रजः R. 8. 32; प्रकृतीरवेक्षितुं 18 inquire into; Ś. 6. --7 To expect, hope for.

s: strI, (ava + Ikza + a + tatazwAp .) pratyavekzaRaM । pratyakzadfzwiH । tatparyyAyaH । pratijAgaraH 2 । ityamaraH । (avaDAnam । anusanDAnam । yaTA, -- “alabDamicCeddaRqena labDaM rakzedavekzayA । rakzitaM vardDayet vfdDyA vfdDaM dAnena nikzipet” ॥ iti manuH । (“yadi rAmasya nAvekzA tvayi syAnmAtfvatsadA” । iti rAmAyaRe .)
m: अवेक्षा f. observation, care, attention to (loc.), Mn. vii, 101; R.; BhP.
a: अवेक्षा — 1 Seeing, looking at. --2 Attention, care, regard; लब्धं रक्षेदवेक्षया Ms. 7. 101; अत्रास्त्यवेक्षा त्वयि मे Rām. --3 Agreement, engagement.

k.v: विप्रलम्भो विप्रयोगो विलम्भस्त्वतिसर्जनम्. विश्रावस्तु प्रतिख्यातिरवेक्षा प्रतिजागरः॥

v: tri॰ ava + Ikza--anIyar । 1 darSanIye । “tapasvisAmAnyamavekzaRIyA” raGuH । 2 AlocanIye ca ।
m: अवेक्षणीय mfn. to be respected, Ragh. xiv, 67.
a: अवेक्षणीय — pot. p. To be looked to or respected, to be looked upon or considered; तपस्विसामान्यमवेक्षणीया R. 14. 67.

s: klI, (ava + Ikza + lyuw .) avekzA ॥ darSanaM । yaTA । “kftAkftAvekzaRavat svayaM tatkuSopaveSanasya karttavyatvAt” । iti saMskAratattvaM । (taTAca । “dUrAdavekzaRaM hAsaH saMpraSne sAdaro BfSam । parokze'pi guRaSlAGA smaraRaM priyavastuzu” ॥ iti hitopadeSe ॥ avaDAnam । pratijAgaraH । anusanDAnam । yaTA, -- “nigfhya SokaM svayameva DImAna varRASramAvekzaRajAgarUkaH .” iti raGuvaMSe ॥)
v: na॰ ava + Ikza--lyuw । 1 darSane, 2 pratijAgaraRe, 3 avaDAne ca “varRRASramAvekzaRajAgarUkaH” raGuH “BUzARAmardDaracanA vfTA vizvagavekzaRam” sA॰ da॰ “pitryamantrAnuharaRe AtmAlamBe hyavekzaRe” SrA॰ ta॰ smf॰
m: अवेक्षण n. looking towards or at, Gaut.; Sāh.
(said of planets) the being in sight, VarBṛS.
the act of considering, attention, observation, Ragh. xiv, 85, &c.
a: अवेक्षणं — 1 Looking towards or at, seeing. --2 Guarding, watching over, protection, taking care of, attending to, supervision, inspection; वर्णाश्रमावेक्षणजागरूकः R. 14. 85; हस्त्यश्वावेक्षणेऽनाभियुक्तः Mu. 3. --3 Attention, care, observation. --4 Regarding, considering; see अनवेक्षणं.

v: tri॰ ava + Ikza--Rvul । 1 darSake 2 paryyAlocake 3 AyavyayAdizu aDyakze ca ।
a: अवेक्षक — a. 1 Showing, showing all round. --2 Inspecting, supervising; a superintendent.

m: अवेक्षता f. foresight, Divyāv.
अवेक्षिन् mfn. looking towards or at, Pañcat.
attentive to (acc.), MBh. v, 1423.
a: अवेक्षिन् — a. Seeing, observing; धर्मावेक्षिता Ś. 5. regard for justice or righteousness.

s: tri, (ava + Ikza + kta .) dfzwaM । yaTA manuH । “keSakIwAvapannaYca padA spfzwaYca kAmataH । BrURaGnAvekzitaYcEva saMspfzwaYcApyudakyayA” ॥ ityAhnikAcAratattvam ॥ (kftAvaDAnaH । yaTA, raGuvaMSe । “sa kadAcidavekzitaprajaH” .)
v: tri॰ ava + Ikza karmmaRi--kta । 1 dfzwe 2 paryyAlocite ca ।

m: अवेक्षितव्य mfn. to be observed attentively, Suśr.

v: tri॰ ava + Ikza--tfc striyAM NIp । avekzakaSabdArTe ।
a: अवेक्षितृ — a. Looking at; thinking of, regarding &c.

v: tri॰ ava + Ikza--karmmaRi Ryat । 1 paryyAlocye 2 dfSye ca lyap । 3 dfzwvetyarTe 4 paryyAlocyetyarTe ca avya॰ ।
m: अवेक्ष्य mfn. to be attended to, MBh. ii, 2591; Yājñ. iii, 63; R.

s: strI, pUgacarvvitaM । iti medinI ॥ civAna guyA iti BAzA । aparAhRaH । iti lokaprasidDaM । velASUnye tri ॥
m: अ-वेला f. wrong time, Lāṭy.
chewed betel, L.

s: puM, (nAsti velA yasya saH .) apalApaH । apahnavaH । iti medinI ॥
v: tri॰ nAsti velA sImA yatra । 1 sImArahite nirmaryyAde 2 apalApe pu॰ 3 cUrRRaguvAke strI medi॰ । aprASastye na॰ ta॰ । 4 anucitakAle strI । na॰ va॰ । 5 samayaSUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-वेल m. (?), denial or concealment of knowledge, L.
a: अवेल — a. 1 Having no boundary or limit, unlimited. --2 Having no time, untimely. --लः Concealment of knowledge. --ला 1 Unfavourable time. --2 Chewed betel (supposed to be = अव+इला).

m: अ-वेलम् ind. untimely, Kathās.
अ-वेनत् mfn. not having any wish or desire, RV. x, 27, 16.
अवेन्व् (√ इन्व्), (Imper. 2. du. -इन्वतम्) to send down (as rain), RV. vii, 64, 2.
अवेत mfn. elapsed, passed, (अन्- neg.), TS.
one who has gained, obtained (with acc.), Pā, v, 1, 134.
a: अवेत — p. p. 1 Elapsed, past. --2 Obtained, attained. --3 Joined or united with.

v: tri॰ ava + yaja--kta । nASite “avezwAdaMdaSUkAH” ya॰ 10, 10, “avapUrvvoyajatirnASArTaH” vedadI॰ “avezwA iti lOhAyasamAviDyati” kAtyA॰ 15, 5, 22 ।

m: अवेष्टि f. (√ यज्), appeasing or expiation by sacrifices, ŚBr.; TBr.
a: अवेष्टिः — Ved. Expiation(of sins) by sacrifices.
